dataset.name: Ego2Web
dataset.license_or_access_note: Ego2Web source videos are retained locally for research screening under the upstream dataset terms. These mined rows are not release tasks; frame redistribution and product-asset licensing must be reviewed before any public benchmark release.

original_annotations: On amazon.com, open the product page for the second book that the person wipes and then places on the shelf in the video. Use what’s visible on its cover to identify the correct edition.

observed_events.description: A yellow-and-red-covered book is held and wiped close to the camera.
A physically different red-and-white-covered book is then handled and wiped.

screening.proposed_initial_target: the first yellow-and-red-covered book wiped in the selected sequence
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the first book I wipe in this sequence. Add one visually matching book to the cart and submit it; do not switch to a later book.

supported_claims.text: V0 shows a yellow-and-red-covered book being handled and wiped first.
V1 later shows a physically different red-and-white-covered book; it does not change which book was first.

tasks.rejection_reason: V0 mainly exposes the back and edge of a yellow-and-red book and does not reveal a stable title or edition. The closest frozen-site book image has a materially different front cover, so the requested first book cannot be linked to one honest and unique website entity.

original_annotations: On amazon.com, open the product page for the first textbook the person flips through in the video and verify you have the correct listing by matching what’s on the cover. Then note the edition number shown on the listing.
Using amazon.com and ebay.com, find the lowest Buy It Now price for the same edition of the third textbook shown in the video. Provide the two product links (one from each site) and the prices.

observed_events.description: A gray-and-white textbook is held, opened and wiped.
A physically different yellow Calculus textbook is later held and wiped.

screening.proposed_instruction: Find the first textbook I examine in this sequence. Add one matching edition to the cart and submit it; do not switch to a later textbook.

supported_claims.text: V0 shows a gray-and-white textbook being examined first.
V1 later shows a visibly different yellow Calculus textbook; it does not change which textbook was first.

tasks.rejection_reason: The first textbook is visibly distinct from the later yellow Calculus book, but neither of the frozen-site engineering-textbook images matches the first cover shown in V0. A title or edition cannot be recovered reliably from the released pixels, so there is no honest unique website target.

original_annotations: Please look up on Wikipedia the growing conditions of the second plant that the person cuts in the video.

observed_events.description: The wearer chops a pale clove-like ingredient on the board.
The wearer later cuts a green pepper on the same board.

screening.proposed_initial_target: the pale chopped ingredient handled before the green pepper
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the first ingredient I cut in this sequence, before the green pepper. Add one matching grocery product to the cart and submit it; keep the first ingredient as the target.

supported_claims.text: V0 shows a pale clove-like ingredient being cut before the later green pepper.
V1 later shows a green pepper being cut on the same board; the later ingredient does not replace the one requested first.

tasks.rejection_reason: V0 clearly shows a pale diced ingredient before the later green pepper, but neither the exact frames nor the source annotation determine whether the first ingredient is garlic, mushroom, eggplant, or another pale produce item. The temporal role is visible, but it cannot be mapped to one auditable grocery product, so the checker target would be constructor-defined rather than evidence-defined.

original_annotations: Go to wikipedia.org and open the article for the ingredient that is added to the mixture between 01:00 and 01:10 in the video. Ensure the article describes it as a common leavening agent used in baking.
On amazon.com, find a grocery product page for the same ingredient that is first opened in the video. Choose a single-unit listing eligible for Prime shipping and open its product page.

observed_events.description: A blue ingredient packet is held and opened at the counter.
A physically different yellow packet is later held and opened.

screening.proposed_initial_target: the blue ingredient packet opened first
screening.proposed_later_state: a yellow ingredient packet opened later
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the ingredient packet I open first in this sequence. Add one matching single-unit product to the cart and submit it; do not switch to the later yellow packet.

supported_claims.text: V0 shows a blue ingredient packet being held and opened first.
V1 later shows a physically different yellow ingredient packet; it does not change which packet was opened first.

tasks.rejection_reason: The video supports the temporal order of a blue packet followed by a yellow packet, but the frozen site has no product image that honestly matches the first blue packet. The available blue baking-powder listings and later yellow corn-flour packet do not establish a unique source-to-site identity from pixels alone.

original_annotations: On imdb.com, open the title page for the film whose poster is being measured at the very start of the video and report its original release year as listed on IMDb.
On ikea.com, select a floating wall shelf whose length most closely matches (but does not exceed) the horizontal span being measured on the white wall. Provide the product link and the shelf length.

observed_events.description: The Casablanca poster is visible close-up while its width is measured.
The wearer measures an empty wall; the poster is no longer visible.

screening.proposed_initial_target: the Casablanca poster measured at the start
screening.proposed_later_state: an empty wall being measured after the poster leaves view
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the film shown on the poster measured at the start, save its media record, and report its release year; keep that film as the target after the poster leaves view.

supported_claims.text: V0 clearly shows a Casablanca poster being measured at the start.
V1 later shows the wall being measured after the poster has left view; absence does not revoke the initial poster target.

tasks.rejection_reason: The source task is an IMDb fact lookup, which does not require the interactive media-selection workflow measured by EgoMedia.

original_annotations: On YouTube, find a video where the same handheld power tool model used in the video is used to remove lug nuts on a car of the same make, and where the creator states the lug nut torque specification. Open the video and report the stated torque value.

On Amazon, locate a front brake rotor product whose fitment explicitly includes the same vehicle make as in the video. Choose a listing where product images show a rotor with the same wheel stud hole count as on the vehicle in the video. Open the product page and provide its title and ASIN.

observed_events.description: A green handheld impact wrench is used on the wheel lug nuts.
The wheel and tire dominate the later view after the impact wrench has left the active scene.

screening.proposed_initial_target: the green impact wrench used first
screening.proposed_later_state: the wheel and tire handled later after the tool leaves view
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the green power tool I use first on the wheel. Add one visually matching impact wrench to the cart and submit it; keep that tool as the target when the later wheel view arrives.

tasks.rejection_reason: Dense review of 10-16 s shows a socket set and a manual socket at the wheel, not the green impact wrench asserted by the source annotation. The decisive target is absent from the released packet, so changing timestamps cannot make this construct valid.

original_annotations: On Amazon, open a product page for a long wooden cooking utensil (set or single) explicitly marketed for deep frying or hot oil tasks, suitable for use with a countertop fryer like in the video.

On YouTube, find and open a dipping-sauce recipe video that uses the same bottled ingredient portioned in the clip near the middle of the video, and ensure it appears as ingredients in the video or description.

observed_events.description: A long wooden slotted cooking utensil is used over the countertop fryer.
The utensil is no longer active while the wearer reaches for and handles a red-capped bottled ingredient.

screening.proposed_initial_target: the long wooden slotted utensil used over the fryer
screening.proposed_later_state: a red-capped bottled ingredient handled after the utensil leaves view
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the long wooden slotted utensil I use over the fryer before reaching for the bottle. Add one matching cooking utensil to the cart and submit it; keep the utensil as the target when the later bottle view arrives.

supported_claims.text: V0 shows a long wooden slotted cooking utensil being used over the fryer.
V1 later shows a red-capped bottle while the wooden utensil is no longer the active object; this does not change which utensil was requested.

tasks.rejection_reason: V1 changes from a wooden utensil to an unrelated bottle. Because the two objects are from different categories and the instruction already names the utensil, the later packet creates no plausible target revision and does not test retention; one starting image measures the same web decision.
